definitions.explanation: The area of land along the edge of the sea. The boundary between land and ocean.

examples.japanese: {海岸|かいがん}を{歩|ある}きました。
{夏|なつ}は{海岸|かいがん}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I go to the beach in summer.

examples.japanese: {海岸|かいがん}から{海|うみ}を{見|み}ました。
examples.english: I looked at the sea from the shore.

notes: Combines {海|うみ} (sea) and {岸|きし} (shore/bank). Similar to but more general than 砂浜 (すなはま, sandy beach). Japan has extensive coastlines, and many cities are located along the {海岸|かいがん}.
